🎥🎬: Family Guy Halloween Special (2026)

Halloween in Quahog is anything but ordinary when Peter Griffin and his family get caught up in another round of outrageous situations. What should be a night of spooky fun quickly turns into a ridiculous adventure, with Peter’s questionable decisions and the family’s bizarre reactions making everything ten times worse.
As Stewie and Brian bring their own mischief to the festivities, Lois finds herself dealing with the consequences of yet another Griffin family disaster. With unpredictable comedy and the show’s signature dark humor, Halloween becomes a night nobody in Quahog will forget.
The Family Guy Halloween Special is now streaming on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+. Watch the full episode for all the chaos!
